question: Which country has the highest gdp per capita among lower middle income group?
query: SELECT      c.country_name,     c.gdp_per_capita FROM global_development_indicators i JOIN (     SELECT country_code,             gdp_per_capita     FROM global_development_indicators     WHERE income_group = 'lower_middle_income' ) AS lower_middle_gdp ON i.year = lower_middle_gdp.year AND                          i.country_code = lower_middle_gdp.country_code AND                         i.gdp_per_capita > lower_middle_gdp.gdp_per_capita  WHERE gdp_per_capita IS NOT NULL      AND country_name IS NOT NULL     AND income_group = 'lower_middle_income' ORDER BY gdp_per_capita DESC LIMIT 50;
